Canonical prior sensitivity grid for joint marginal cluster models

Source: R/marginal-analysis.R
catmech_marginal_sensitivity_grid.Rd

Automatically computes the prespecified 2-axis prior sensitivity protocol from the Joint Marginal validation specification:

  1. Covariance scale axis: \(\text{prior\_scale} \in \{0.25, 1.0, 4.0\}\), holding regression scale fixed at 10.

  2. Regression scale axis: \(\text{regression\_scale} \in \{5, 10, 20\}\), holding covariance scale fixed at 1.0.

Usage

catmech_marginal_sensitivity_grid(
  fit,
  term = NULL,
  formula = NULL,
  prior_scales = c(0.25, 1, 4),
  regression_scales = c(5, 10, 20),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  reference = 0
)

Arguments

fit

A fitted catmech_result from catmech_reference with cluster_model = "joint_marginal", or a named list of precomputed scenarios.

term

Name of the target coefficient to assess. If NULL, defaults to the first modeled predictor or formula covariate.

formula

Optional formula passed to catmech_marginal_summary for custom outcome specifications.

prior_scales

Numeric vector of covariance prior scales to evaluate (default c(0.25, 1, 4)).

regression_scales

Numeric vector of regression prior scales to evaluate (default c(5, 10, 20)).

conf_level

Credible level (default 0.95).

reference

Reference value for direction checks (default 0).

Value

An object of class "catmech_marginal_sensitivity_grid" containing:

table

Data frame of sensitivity results per scenario.

axis_summary

Summary comparing mean absolute shifts along each axis to MCSE bounds.

statistic

Primary sensitivity statistic: \(\max(\text{mean\_abs\_change}_{\text{cov}}, \text{mean\_abs\_change}_{\text{reg}})\).

mcse_mean

Monte Carlo standard error of the posterior mean under the baseline prior.

term

The evaluated coefficient term.

baseline

Baseline scenario result row.

status

Sensitivity status from catmech_sensitivity.

complete

Logical indicating whether all evaluated scenarios succeeded.

envelope

Credible interval envelope across successful scenarios.

raw_sensitivity

Underlying output from catmech_sensitivity.

Details

Evaluates the average absolute change in the posterior mean under the alternative hyperparameters along each axis, and returns the primary sensitivity statistic (the maximum of the two axis-level mean changes) along with Monte Carlo standard errors.
